properties_quiet_hours_pair_ck.name: properties_quiet_hours_pair_ck
properties_quiet_hours_pair_ck.value: ("properties"."quiet_hours_start" is null and "properties"."quiet_hours_end" is null) or ("properties"."quiet_hours_start" is not null and "properties"."quiet_hours_end" is not null)

units_size_requires_unit_ck.name: units_size_requires_unit_ck
units_size_requires_unit_ck.value: ("units"."size" is null and "units"."size_unit" is null) or ("units"."size" is not null and "units"."size_unit" is not null)

tenant_visible_users.name: tenant_visible_users
tenant_visible_users.using:
exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.user_id = users.id
          and m.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
      )
